tagline: Five things worth knowing. Refreshed daily.

items.headline: Anthropic leapfrogs OpenAI; files for IPO at $965B
items.summary: Anthropic is now the world's most valuable AI startup. Confidential S-1 filed 1 June; OpenAI's offering may follow this year.

items.headline: Microsoft ships first in-house models: MAI-Code-1-Flash + MAI-Thinking-1
items.summary: Coding model that turns plain-language briefs into shipping code, plus a low-cost reasoning model. Signals reduced OpenAI dependence.

items.headline: Google's Gemini 3.1 Ultra lands
items.summary: Strongest on multimodal + very large context — docs, code, images, research files in a single window. GPT-5.5 still rated best for premium prose.

items.headline: The big shift: vendors stop selling models, start selling the runtime
items.summary: Build, Google I/O, ServiceNow Knowledge all pitched the same thing — governed runtimes for autonomous agents. Microsoft Agent 365 hit GA; Nvidia + ServiceNow shipped audited agent ops.

items.headline: IBM unveils "AI Operating Model" blueprint at Think 2026
items.summary: Framework for the widening gap between AI leaders and laggards — focused on integrating agents into how the enterprise actually runs, not just where it experiments.
